title: Vesper
description: A cloud of mint and violet light breathes as an orb, blows open into a spiral galaxy, and gathers itself into a thinking brain — a dark, living interface that answers every move you make.

title: Stride
description: Modern banking rendered as momentum — a deep-blue fintech landing where a filament of light pulses at the heart of the hero, cool, precise, and quietly in motion.

title: AI Studio
description: A chrome star turns in the dark and the whole page becomes one cinematic scroll — violet light, a bloom of drifting particles, and a camera that flies clean through it. A neural-brand showreel that thinks ahead.

title: Creative Director
description: A portfolio that smolders — molten reds drift like a lava lamp beneath film grain while case studies glide past in a slow heat haze.

title: Dantora
description: A medical clinic told through ink in water — a green double helix that never stops shedding plumes, swirling outward on an evolving noise flow and parting wherever your cursor goes, with photographs trailing off the pointer, a rail of services that scrubs sideways under your scroll, and every block riding up over the one before it.

title: Clarix
description: A cinematic scroll where a holographic ASCII model dissolves into being, words fly through space, and a logo assembles itself from thousands of glowing particles.

title: Relay
description: A workflow-automation landing page in black and lime where one stream of light runs the whole length of the site: a lime ring counts the page in and folds away into the logo, a live refund flow runs inside a tilting glass window in the hero, a plate opens out of the logo and folds back into it mid-page, and every section from a Tuesday dashboard to a pricing meter you drag arrives out of focus and settles like a precise mechanism.

title: Artefakt
description: A near-black outerwear concept drawn on a lattice that lights up in squares under your cursor, where a lacquered, iridescent jacket travels down the page from one screen to the next — turning to your hand, sleeves trailing a beat behind — and every label decodes out of static as it arrives.

title: Brewns
description: A specialty coffee house one-pager where a drawn cup fills and pours away to open the page, a bag and cup of beans stand in a lit studio you can grab and spin, four product cards lean toward your hand, an iced latte turns on a clock face as you scroll, coffee beans drift weightless behind a tilted cup, and a thermal printer feeds your receipt out of its slot.

title: House
description: A cinematic fly-through of a glass house that you scrub with the scroll, statement words pinned to its corners, an interior riding up behind a frosted panel, stats counting up on a blurred drum, a star warping out to swallow the screen and a showreel zooming through it — then a footer uncovered like a curtain with its wordmark rising letter by letter.

title: Flora
description: A private-relay protocol’s launch page told as one long camera move through a dandelion drawn in light: the page opens through a keyhole onto the plant swaying once in a night field where a fire front creeps, the head turns and lets its seeds go as you scroll, a flower opens where the core was and an iris gathers in the dark after it, readings fly off with the petals, and six screens of copy set with a script S take their turns over the same stretch of scroll, from “Send first. Be seen later” to an invitation to be someone else’s first hop.

title: Wanderlust
description: A dark, windswept travel site that lingers on wide country and quiet mornings — the kind of page that makes leaving feel overdue.

title: Halden
description: A Danish furniture house on warm paper and brand red, where the hero's photographs uncover and turn red under your hand, a manifesto writes itself letter by letter around two cut-out chairs that rock when pointed at, a red band slides down a catalogue of nine categories with tilted previews riding along, product cards flood a chip red as you approach, and a spotlight picks each piece out of a Copenhagen apartment.

title: Longplay
description: A single screen of blue meadow you can comb with your cursor, a floating television lighting the grass from the crest, cyan motes rising through a cumulus sky, and a viewfinder frame of frosted pills and hairlines that blur in around a script headline once a counting curtain lifts.

title: New Era
description: A luminous swarm of orange-and-blue particles drifts through deep space, endlessly reshaping itself as you scroll — a cinematic voyage from a single point of light to a vast spiral galaxy.

title: Ridgeline
description: A Portland roofer's one-pager whose headline slides shut like a seam over a full-bleed standing-seam roof, with callouts that type themselves onto the photograph when you point at a seam, a statement that fills in letter by letter while four figures roll up like a counter, service cards that clear out of a blur, an accordion walking through the four steps of a job, marker-pinned photographs of finished roofs, and a closing photograph that shrinks from the whole screen into its frame before the request form fades up beside it.

title: AI Creator
description: A photogrammetry bust on a porcelain stage that burns in as the curtain lifts, dissolves into a live blue fire-field as you scroll, and sends its own wireframe travelling across the screen to assemble a chromed "AI" — before seven photographs fold round a box and the invitation rides up on a tilting blue plane.

title: Codescan
description: A dark room where a figure stands watching a wall of televisions — the lens drifts after your cursor and racks focus onto whatever set you touch, then flies past the wall, through two lines standing in the fog, and finds a portfolio assembling itself out of the haze.

title: Northwall
description: A construction firm's one-pager that opens behind a monogram filling like a gauge while photographs are dealt out like cards, the last one growing out of the deck to become the hero itself, a gallery of concrete and glass turning under five rotating disciplines, project cards that draw themselves open from the top, five process steps that blur away behind a photograph tilting toward your hand, and a single portrait that travels down the team rows to whichever name you point at.

title: Auralis
description: One unbroken camera flight through a silver studio where thousands of glowing beads keep changing their mind about what they are — an X that bursts into violet ribbons, a hand that crumbles into a rippling curtain, and a tree that grows out of the fog for the finale.

title: Aerra
description: A house standing alone on a mountain slope at dusk, its name set eight hundred pixels tall behind it — letters that climb apart as you scroll, a valley you repaint by moving the cursor over it, a facade you turn in your hand, and a matte-black mark drifting the whole length of the page behind glass.

title: Altitude
description: A still mountain night that stirs to life wherever the cursor drifts — warm and cool ink swirls through the dark and bends the starlit sky behind an invitation to stays past the end of the road.

title: Lumea
description: A stone monk meditates on a floating rock in a near-black void — ringed by glowing amber orbit lines and a slow spiral of tumbling debris that parts around your cursor, under one soft shaft of light and a camera that never stops circling.

title: Forma
description: A violet lavender valley ripples under your cursor as a studio's contact page assembles itself — heading, form, and cards settling in one by one.

title: Evolve
description: A jet-black AI hero where a human head of tens of thousands of glowing particles — blue key, red rim — drifts, breathes and turns to follow the cursor over a hairline blueprint grid, while the headline sweeps in letter by letter and stat figures settle out of scrambled glyphs.

title: Fromzero
description: A midnight valley where a floating screen turns to meet your cursor — an eye framed by falling code, its light spilling onto a black lake that ripples wherever you point.

title: Noema
description: A portrait dissolving into slow-drifting light against deep navy, split by a towering serif headline — a studio hero that feels like a thought catching form.

title: Helion
description: A field of blue particles spirals into a slow vortex and draws together into a single mark — the dark, gravitational hero for a studio that promises to give brands weight.

title: Lumen
description: A debit card surfaces from a moonlit sea, tilting to your touch as ripples fan across the water beneath a brass gate on the horizon — a fintech hero with the calm of still water.

title: Negantropy
description: A scroll through deep space where cosmic particle fields assemble, ignite, and pour through an hourglass — a cinematic tribute to refusing to fall apart.

title: Stride Nine
description: Two sprinters caught mid-stride against a deep blue sky, a headline set across them in unbroken white caps — and the air itself catching and dragging wherever you move.

title: Vexon
description: A black, GPU-particle halo breathes behind a dark AI landing where data resolves into your unfair advantage.

title: Voxelia
description: A cobalt-blue, pixel-art-flavoured hero where twelve glossy chess pieces swarm a glowing white king under real physics — shove them with the cursor and they tumble, collide and coast back — while a soft field of pixel waves ripples behind the card and a pixelated flood of blue does the reveal.

title: GringX
description: An AI decision layer rendered as a living orb of blue light, cupped in open hands against the dark — calm, luminous, and quietly futuristic.

title: Stackside
description: A grayscale portrait dissolves into halftone dots and turns beneath your pointer — a cool, editorial hero for a finance product with something to prove.

title: Creative Studio
description: A void-black creative-studio hero where a solar swell of amber particles ripples beneath faint orbital rings — identity and art direction rendered as light in motion.

title: Dringle
description: Chrome hands cradle a slowly turning star over a pour of violet glass, while a light, unhurried hero makes its case — a brand studio polished until it's the one you reach for.

title: Cortex
description: Threads of chromatic light bend and sway toward your cursor across the dark, while a colossal wordmark rises from the fold — a landing hero that feels like intelligence coming online.

title: Halcyon
description: A  pocket watch drifts above an endless sea as the sky burns from dawn to dusk to moonlit night — a slow, cinematic voyage for a timepiece made to outlast generations. 3D watch model was created by Eddyson Work (https://sketchfab.com/LepriconGreen)

title: Neural Monitor
description: A luminous point-cloud brain hangs in the dark while the scan glides region by region — then lets go, scattering into a living constellation of signal.

title: Clair
description: A prism-glass lightning bolt hangs in a slow indigo current, splitting the light into violet and amber as it leans toward you — a dark, exacting hero for a product that promises the clearer call.

title: Soda
description: A 3D soda can floats and follows your cursor while berries scatter from your touch and the whole world shifts color when you pick a flavor.

title: Kimi
description: A Formula 1 driver's site where the helmet burns off his portrait as the page loads and comes back only where your cursor has just been, the season's circuit runs a lap when you reach it, and every block after that lands over the last one like a stack of cards.

title: Lumora
description: An independent design-and-engineering studio rendered in near-black calm — bold work surfacing with quiet, fluid precision as the page drifts past.

title: Laocoon
description: A cinematic WebGL homage to the Laocoön — a glowing bronze sculpture you orbit as you scroll, wrapped in molten forge sparks and a breathing liquid-metal shader that drifts from bronze to deep sapphire.

title: Baseline
description: A members' tennis club and academy carried with championship poise — deep court-blue, confident type, and a calm scroll that reveals the coaching, the courts, and the pedigree one beat at a time.

title: Loopstack
description: A black canvas where a flower blooms behind your every word, and a glowing cursor whispers hello.

title: Ascend
description: A living Earth turns in deep space behind a mint-lit SaaS landing page — city lights, drifting clouds, and radar pings glowing as the planet sinks and swings with every scroll.

title: Flowstate
description: A living fluid drifts through ink-dark calm as a single line settles into place — a hero built for focus, stillness, and deep work.

title: Marcus Vane
description: A founder stands framed inside his own towering name — a cinematic, dark study in conviction, ventures, and two decades of building the impossible.

title: Gravity
description: A WebGL field of glossy spheres that drops, scatters, and reassembles into a heart as you scroll — chasing your cursor the whole way.

title: Kai Nomura
description: A generative artist's portfolio in hushed, monochrome minimalism — works of light, code, and memory drifting past as you scroll.

title: Kumo
description: A hand-painted animation studio told as one unbroken shot through an autumn city, sewn together by clouds.

title: Held-Mint
description: Rare collectible cards locked behind graffiti-tagged steel, barbed wire and a stamp that seals the pile.
